title: Competitive model buckets & signal watchlist: prioritized research plan
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a prioritized, executable research plan that (1) classifies public model providers and open model variants into competitive 'buckets' relevant to Redwood Inference GTM and product roadmap, (2) defines a short-list 'signal watchlist' of features, price/latency tradeoffs, and platform behaviors to monitor weekly, and (3) outputs concrete recommended product responses (pricing/positioning/compatibility) for the next three quarters.
context: PM-level ask from Growth + Product Strategy: Marketing and Sales are seeing variable customer questions about model fit (e.g., cost vs latency for embedding-heavy workflows, on-prem quantized variants for compliance, and hallucination/regression patterns for instruction-following models). Need a pragmatic, repeatable taxonomy and an operational watchlist that Product, Solutions, and Developer Relations can rely on.
outcomes: 1) A one-page competitive bucket map for execs. 2) A living watchlist with 10 signals and data sources. 3) Recommended 3-step product responses (Immediate: docs/FAQ, Next quarter: packaging/pricing experiments, 90–180d: runtime/optimizer roadmap items).
success_metrics: Watchlist updated weekly with at least 2 validated signals
Sales/SEs report reduced ad-hoc model questions by 40% in 6 weeks
A/B test of new packaging shows 8% lift in trial-to-paid among embedding-heavy customers
approach: 1) Desktop research: crawl public release notes, benchmarks (MLPerf/Eleuther/BigScience community posts), vendor pricing pages. 2) Signal triangulation: pull telemetry (aggregate latency/cost percentiles) from Console dashboards, review recent Dedicated contract asks, and interview 8 customer-facing SEs. 3) Categorize models into buckets based on business-relevant axes (latency sensitivity, embedding quality, hallucination risk, on-prem friendliness, quantization viability). 4) Create watchlist with concrete measurement heuristics and triage playbooks.
deliverables: Competitive bucket diagram (PNG + CSV of model metadata)
1-page executive memo with recommended product moves
Confluence page with methodology and data sources
data_sources: Public pricing pages for major vendors
Github release notes for open models (Llama/XLM family forks)
acceptance_criteria: Bucket map reviewed and approved by Head of Product
Watchlist includes measurement definitions and data source links for all 10 signals
Confluence memo has at least 2 recommended product actions with owners and timeframes
risks_and_mitigations: Signal noise from early telemetry: mitigate with sample-size threshold and rolling windows
Competitive pages change frequently: set weekly snapshot job and note age on entries
Customer bias in interviews: balance with passive telemetry and 3rd-party benchmarks
notes_and_decisions: 2026-03-04: Decided to prioritize embeddings and on-prem quantization signals for the first iteration after SE input. 2026-03-08: Leaned away from pricing parity comparisons as a primary axis because customers care more about unit economics (latency/token) than headline price. Need to align with Growth before any public messaging.
